title: Tech worth paying for vs skip
hook: Car tech worth paying extra for (and what to skip)
caption:
Top variants love bundling flashy features with genuinely useful ones, so you pay for both. 💸

Here's my take on what's worth stretching the budget for, and what looks great in the showroom but changes little in daily life.

Disagree with any of these? I'd genuinely love to hear why. What's one feature YOU would never buy a car without? 👇

Save this for your next variant comparison.

slides.heading: Car tech worth paying extra for (and what to skip)
Worth it: 360 degree camera
slides.body: Tight parking and narrow lanes are everyday India. It saves bumpers and a lot of stress.

slides.heading: Worth it: Wireless Android Auto and CarPlay
slides.body: No cable mess, connects as you sit in. Check it is actually wireless, not just supported with a cable.

slides.heading: Worth it: 6 airbags and ESC
slides.body: Not flashy, but this is the tech that matters most when something goes wrong.

slides.heading: Think twice: Ambient lighting packs
slides.body: Looks lovely at night. Changes nothing about how the car drives or protects you.

slides.heading: Think twice: Big screens with laggy software
slides.body: Size is not speed. Test touch response and boot time in the showroom before you pay.

slides.heading: Follow @decodethedrive
slides.body: Honest, plain-language car tech advice so your money goes to features you will actually use.
